svg.title: TTFT is what the user feels. Detection is the incident.
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “TTFT is what the user feels. Detection is the incident.” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A hand-drawn comparison of two timelines of identical total length: BUFFERED shows a flat grey bar labelled 'the user sees NOTHING - 4.00 s' ending in a burst, while STREAMED shows a 0.90 second prefill segment followed by a hachured region of words appearing that ends at the same 4-second mark, with a dashed amber line at 0.90 seconds marking TTFT. A small stacked bar breaks that 0.90 s into guardrail 180 ms, retrieval 210, queue 40 and model prefill 470. Below, an incident timeline runs from a provider model update through a scheduled eval detecting minus 6.2 points at 11 hours, pinning at 11 hours 20, root cause at 3 days and a fix at 4 days, with a crossed-out marker at 9 days reading 'a user tells us - this is the default', and a bracket over the first two markers labelled DETECTION.
svg.text: TTFT is what the user feels. Detection is the incident.
draw it from memory, then compare
